hints.title: Divide and Conquer Sorting
hints.text: Split the array into two halves, recursively sort each half, and merge the sorted halves in linear time.

hints.title: Midpoint Splitting
hints.text: Divide the active range at mid = (low + high) // 2. Recursively sort left and right ranges.

hints.title: Two Pointer Merging Pass
hints.text: Merge the two sorted subarrays by comparing current elements with two pointers, writing into temporary storage, then copying back.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def sortArray(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        if len(nums) <= 1:
            return nums
        mid = len(nums) // 2
        left = self.sortArray(nums[:mid])
        right = self.sortArray(nums[mid:])
        merged = []
        i = j = 0
        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                merged.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                merged.append(right[j])
                j += 1
        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])
        return merged
```

complexity.notes: Merge sort with guaranteed O(N log N) worst-case performance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic sorts like bubble or insertion sort timeout on arrays of length 50000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement merge sort or heap sort to guarantee O(N log N) worst-case time.
